Typeform

Collect useful enquiries and pass them to the right workflow.

TOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Typeform supports interactive forms and documented APIs for form creation, responses, and webhooks. MoreSpace can design a focused enquiry or onboarding experience that asks useful questions, captures approved data, and creates a clean handoff to sales or operational systems.

Useful outputs

  • Reviewed forms with clear completion and next-step messaging
  • Validated response mappings and monitored webhook handoffs
  • Form performance reporting and a prioritized improvement backlog

Where we can apply it

  • Website enquiry → Typeform qualification → validated webhook → CRM owner.
  • Client onboarding → structured answers → operational record → assigned next steps.
  • Form performance → friction review → revised question flow → completion comparison.
01

Use case 1

Build service enquiry forms with relevant qualification questions.

02

Use case 2

Connect validated responses with CRM ownership and onboarding records.

03

Use case 3

Analyze form completion and question-level friction using available response data.

Inputs we need

  • Enquiry or onboarding goals and approved question set
  • Required CRM fields, consent wording, and data retention rules
  • Response routing, owner assignment, and follow-up responsibilities

Delivery sequence

  • Define the minimum useful questions and the meaning of a qualified response.
  • Build and test the form, response mapping, and duplicate handling.
  • Connect reviewed responses to the intended workflow and inspect completion quality.

Expert review points

  • Approve consent wording, collected fields, and customer-facing form content.
  • Check webhook retries and recipient ownership before routing live responses.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

Signals we can make visible

  • Form completion rate
  • Drop-off rate

  • Lead routing time
